profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley's vLLM team develops an open-source, high-throughput inference engine for large language models. The project is hosted on GitHub and emphasizes self-hosted deployment with no external data sharing, positioning itself as a resource for developers seeking local LLM inference capabilities.

vLLM is the team's primary product offering in the open-source and self-hosted models category. As a university lab initiative rather than a for-profit enterprise, the work reflects Berkeley's academic focus on advancing AI infrastructure and tools for the broader developer community.
